title: Non-record concrete value classes should explicitly override equals and hashCode; prefer a value record, or delegate to super.equals and super.hashCode if state-wise identity comparison is intended.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Value-based classes do not have identity; relying on identity semantics (such as WeakReference, IdentityHashMap, synchronization, or identity-based caches) is unsafe and will fail in a future version of Java.
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.

title: Avoid using `var` with primitive types. Explicit primitive type names are short and clear, and `var` provides no benefit in readability while potentially hiding the type.
